historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to alter the building at 2111 Franklin Street as to the fire escape and spiral stairs, with a condition for a handrail.
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the departments' position requiring provision of a wet standpipe in the building at 2111 Franklin Street.
